title: 헷갈리는 말: 안/않, 되/돼 바르게 쓰기
objective: By the end, you can read short messages and notices and spot wrong uses of 안/않 and 되/돼. You can also correct them using the 하/해 test and the -지 test.
summary: Learn two quick tests for spelling 안 or 않 and 되 or 돼 correctly. Koreans often mix these up in messages and notices because they sound almost the same.
note: The messages and notice in this worksheet are made-up examples for practice.

task.title: Spell it right
task.line: Use the 하/해 test and the -지 test to choose, fix, or write the correct form.

sections.heading: Same sound, different spelling
paragraphs: In speech, 되 and 돼 sound almost the same, and 않아요 sounds like [아나요]. Because of this, even native speakers often mix them up in chats and online comments. It is a bit like your/you're in English.
In a casual chat, a mistake like this is easy to forgive. In a work email, a notice, or a test, it looks careless, so it is worth checking before you send.

sections.heading: Two quick tests
paragraphs: 되/돼 (the 하/해 test): Put 하 or 해 in the same spot. If 해 sounds right, write 돼 (해요 → 돼요, 했어요 → 됐어요, 해서 → 돼서). If 하 sounds right, write 되 (하면 → 되면, 하는 → 되는, 하고 → 되고). Remember: 돼 is just 되어 made shorter.
안/않 (the -지 test): If the word comes after -지 and has an ending (-아요, -고, -으면, -은), write 않. If it stands alone right before a verb or adjective, write 안 and put a space after it.

items.text: 안 goes right before the verb and is always written as a separate word.
않 always comes after -지 and always takes an ending.
Use it when you did one thing without doing another.
Use it for a condition: if you don't do something.
This is 되어요 made shorter, so never write 되요.
This is the past form, from 되었어요.

items.gloss: if it becomes / if it works out
items.text: Before -면, keep 되 (the test word is 하면).
Before -는, keep 되 (the test word is 하는).
This is 되어서 made shorter (the test word is 해서).
This is 안 + 돼요, written as two words.

exercises: Choose the correct form: ① 제 동생은 올해 대학생이 (되요 / 돼요). ② 그 가게는 일요일에 문을 열지 (안아요 / 않아요). ③ 이 노트북은 인터넷이 잘 (안 돼요 / 않 돼요).
Fill in each blank with 되 or 돼: ① 회의 준비가 다 ____면 알려 주세요. ② 제 꿈은 의사가 ____는 거예요. ③ 길이 막혀서 약속에 늦게 ____서 미안해요.
Write O if the spelling is correct and X if it is wrong: ① 이번 주말에는 시간이 안 돼요. ② 그 영화는 별로 재미있지 않았어요. ③ 여기에 주차하면 안되요. ④ 저는 고기를 않 먹어요.
Read the notice and correct the two spelling mistakes: [안내] 이번 주 금요일에는 수업이 없어요. 숙제는 월요일까지 내면 되요. 월요일까지 내지 안으면 점수를 받을 수 없어요.
Answer with -지 않아요: ① 커피 자주 마셔요? ② 그 신발 불편해요?
answers: ① 돼요 ② 않아요 ③ 안 돼요
① 되 (되면) ② 되 (되는) ③ 돼 (돼서)
① O ② O ③ X (안 돼요) ④ X (안 먹어요)
① 아니요, (커피) 자주 마시지 않아요. ② 아니요, 불편하지 않아요.
